subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

It is high time you **leave the room**.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**It is high time**" is typically followed by the past tense to indicate urgency or necessity.
 
• Using the present tense "**leave**" is incorrect in this context.
 
• The correct verb form is "**left**" to align with the idiomatic usage of "It is high time."
 
• Thus, the bold part of the sentence should be replaced with **left the room**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It is high time you left the room."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "have left the room"** – This is incorrect because the present perfect tense does not fit the idiomatic expression "It is high time."
 
• **Option 2: "had left the room"** – This is incorrect because the past perfect tense implies a completed action, which does not match the intended meaning of urgency.
 
• **Option 4: "leaves the room"** – This is incorrect because the present tense does not fit the idiomatic expression "It is high time."
